summary: Iteration 2: Tested new features - profile update, password change, in-chat search, sidebar message content search, and Account settings tab. Backend: 11/11 pytest tests pass (auth/profile empty+valid+no-token, auth/password wrong-current+short-new+valid+relogin+revert, chats/search short-query+no-auth+finds+archived-excluded+case-insensitive+cross-user-isolation). Frontend: admin login, chat import via API, sidebar-search-toggle -> sidebar-search-input with UNIQUE word shows chat-snippet-<id> even though title has no match; typing garbage shows 'No chats found'. Ctrl+F opens chat-search-bar with 2 matches, count 1/2, 2 <mark> highlights, next/prev cycle counter correctly. Account tab visible for regular user, empty name triggers account-name-error, valid rename updates sidebar-user-name instantly (Renamed Live). Wrong current password -> account-password-error 'Current password is incorrect'; mismatched confirm -> 'Passwords do not match'; valid change -> account-password-success; relogin with new password succeeds.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key only closes the search bar when the search input still has focus. After clicking chat-search-prev/next the input can lose focus and Escape becomes a no-op. chat-search-close X button works. Consider attaching the Escape handler at document level while search is open.

Modal cannot be closed with Escape key (same as UserManagement modal in iteration 1). This blocked automated flow that tried Escape -> user-menu after password change; had to be worked around. Use X or Cancel button.

action_items: Optional: add document-level Escape handler in ChatSearchBar so Escape works even when focus moved away from the input.
Optional (repeat from iteration 1): enable Escape-to-close on SettingsModal and UserManagement modal.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow (~765 lines). Splitting into modules (auth, admin, chats, connections, settings) is now more pressing.
GET /api/settings and PUT /api/settings are still unauthenticated (flagged in iteration 1) - anyone can read/overwrite the global system prompt. Should be admin-gated.

Sidebar.jsx /chats/search is called relying on axios.defaults.common Authorization header set by AuthContext. If a page mounts Sidebar before AuthContext hydrates token, request could go out unauth; consider passing headers explicitly to be robust.

ChatSearchBar Escape handler is bound to the input's onKeyDown only, so once the input loses focus (after Next/Prev scroll), Escape stops working - should be a document-level listener while bar is open.
Chat search snippet on backend uses only the first matched message per chat; consider surfacing best/most-recent match rather than first insertion order for better UX.
